title: Add first-pass deterministic mechanics projections for gameplay
description:
Problem:
The pack is source-complete, but many gameplay mechanics remain prose-only after basic top-level fields. This limits deterministic tools for combat, spell use, conditions, resources, and creature actions.

Goal:
Add a first-pass projection layer for commonly needed mechanics without attempting to build a complete rules engine in one bead.

Principles:
- Projection must be derived from SRD text.
- Preserve source prose as canonical audit text.
- Prefer partial, well-tested typed projections over broad brittle parsing.
- Unknown or ambiguous effects should remain prose-backed with explicit lack of projection.

Scope candidates:
- Spell concentration flag from duration.
- Spell attack/save/damage/scaling projection where patterns are clear.
- Creature/action attack bonus, reach/range, target count, hit damage, save DC, and condition application.
- Feature resource counts and recharge/rest reset where explicit.
- Hazard detection/disable/save/damage projections where clear.

Acceptance criteria:
- A report shows which records gained mechanics projections and which remain prose-only.
- Projection fields are optional and schema-visible.
- Tests cover representative spells, creature actions, features, and hazards.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
close_reason: Implemented first-pass source-backed mechanics projections for spells, creature/action entries, features/ancestry/feats, and hazards; regenerated SRD pack; added schema validation, report, thaw note, and tests.
